name: Fitness
goal: Hit the weekly activity guideline through planned sessions: surfing, padel and workouts.

sources.who2020: Bull FC et al. World Health Organization 2020 guidelines on physical activity and sedentary behaviour. Br J Sports Med, 2020.
sources.oja2017: Oja P et al. Associations of specific types of sports and exercise with all-cause and cardiovascular-disease mortality: a cohort study of 80 306 British adults. Br J Sports Med, 2017.
sources.lally2010: Lally P, van Jaarsveld CHM, Potts HWW, Wardle J. How are habits formed: modelling habit formation in the real world. Eur J Soc Psychol, 2010.

rules.title: Weekend surf session
rules.label: Surfing
rules.why: Vigorous sessions count double toward the WHO weekly target (75–150 min vigorous); a fixed weekend slot makes it a habit.
rules.advice: Get in the water before midday.

nudge.text: Surf window opens in 15 minutes — wax the board.

rules.title: Padel game
rules.label: Padel
rules.why: Racket sports showed the strongest association with lower all-cause and cardiovascular mortality among common sports.
rules.advice: Play before dinner so you finish well ahead of bedtime.

nudge.text: Padel in 15 minutes — grab your racket.

rules.title: Strength workout
rules.label: Workout
rules.why: WHO recommends muscle-strengthening activity on 2+ days a week in addition to aerobic activity.
rules.advice: Train before dinner — late, hard sessions disturb sleep.
